edition.notes: The three-volume edition identity is bibliographically controlled. An exact remote scan of volume I is registered for the bounded Ordo XV ordination passage; volumes II–III and manuscript correspondence remain unacquired.
edition.publication: Edited by Cyrille Vogel and Reinhard Elze, 3 vols., Studi e Testi 226–227, 269, Vatican City, 1963–1972
edition.title: Le Pontifical romano-germanique du dixième siècle

passages.context: Printed p. 14 (PDF p. 85) was inspected for XV.7's invitation of candidates by named grades, including exorcist; printed p. 17 (PDF p. 88) was inspected for XV.17–19 between the lector conclusion and XV.20 acolyte opening. The exorcist unit is separately titled, associates the office with a book containing exorcisms, distinguishes baptized persons from catechumens, and contains a preface and blessing. This verifies the critical edition's bounded ordinal architecture only. It does not establish one uncomplicated tenth-century local book, any manuscript reading, actual performance, ordinary duties, frequency, efficacy, continuity into later pontificals, identity with modern major exorcism, current ministry or law, or operational use.
passages.notes: No charge, prayer, or operative wording is transcribed. The critical apparatus on both pages makes witness variation visible, but no siglum-to-manuscript collation was performed.
